exposure: Umbilical coiling index (hypo-coiling, hyper-coiling, normal coiling)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women with term gestation, irrespective of parity.
finding: Abnormal umbilical coiling index was significantly associated with low birth weight and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly associated with abnormal umbilical coiling index (p>0.05).
